messages:
nina: heads-up — multiple customers reporting 503s and timeouts to hosted inference since ~09:05 UTC. spike in rate of API retries and billing complaints. example customer id: cust_9z7. :fire:
lee: seeing a 3x increase in gateway 503s in prod-edge-1 around 09:03. graphs: p99 latency up, 5xx rate up. linking logs now. :eyes:
sanjay: I think this coincided with the matrix-routing feature flip we promoted at 09:00. matrix_switch was supposed to be scoped to canary but looks like the selector used the env tag incorrectly. investigating selector evaluation.
nina: customers say increased errors on short prompts, but also some long-running requests timing out after 18s. billing flagged for duplicate tokens billed due to client retries.
jorge: customer repro steps: curl against api.redwood/v1/generate with key X-API-Key set. sometimes request gets 200, often 503. attaching sample curl.
jorge: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-base-1","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":32}' 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
lee: pasted gateway log snippet: "upstream error: route eval=matrix_switch -> backend=kvkernel-v1, error=kvcache-miss-flood, status=503, route_context=prod"
sanjay: kernel selection service was returning kvkernel-v1 for short sequences because matrix routing forced kernel preference. kvkernel-v1 doesn't have the micro-prefetch optimizations for the short-token path — causes heavy KV cache pressure and evictions.
maya: quick mitigation: can we flip traffic back? deploy-bot: ``deploy-bot: applying rollout override: matrix_switch -> scope=prod:false``
deploy-bot: rollout override applied to all prod nodes. traffic should start draining in ~30s.
lee: after override, 503 rate dropping already in edge-1. p50 latency down.
jorge: confirmed with customer — 200 responses restored for previous failing requests. they still want root cause and bill adjustment.
nina: action items: 1) SRE to validate canary scoping check in selector parser (sanjay + lee). 2) Runtime team to add fallback kernel mapping for short sequences (sanjay + maya). 3) CS to open billing ticket for impacted customers (nina + jorge). 4) Postmortem once stabilized.
sanjay: repro notes — local reproduce by forcing routing header: `X-Matrix-Routing: enabled` and send 500 req/s with short prompts to emulate KV churn. logs show: "kvcache miss rate 82% -> GC thrash". will capture flamegraphs.
lee: rolling a short fix to selector service to reject unscoped matrix_switch toggles and add extra validation. planning hotfix patch.
maya: also recommend adding a canary guard to the rollout API that blocks non-specified envs. filing PR.
jorge: customer billed for retries; CS will request credits. raised ticket INC-20263.
nina: I'll coordinate postmortem and timeline. thanks all for quick triage. :thumbsup:
lee: noted — keep channel updated, ping me if we need rollback assistance.
sanjay: collecting traces and will dump kernel metrics to `/var/logs/kernel-selector/matrix-6301122334.log` for the postmortem.
deploy-bot: audit: detected rollout at 09:00 by maya with selector=matrix_switch scope=canary,false (invalid boolean converted).
